note: Helena-Lewis and Clark NF (Rocky Mountain RD) campground ~30 mi W of Augusta at the end of Benchmark Road (FR 235), near the Bob Marshall Wilderness boundary and the South Fork Sun River; spacious parking aprons. A wilderness trailhead camp with horse camping alongside; mandatory food storage. --Claude
summary: Forest Service (Rocky Mountain RD), first-come (no reservation channel; not on recreation.gov). Confirmed $10 (+$5 extra vehicle; page updated 2026-04-29), 25 sites, vault toilets. Added no potable water, seasonal (late spring to early fall). The page no longer states the 35-ft max trailer (left as recorded). No alert names Benchmark or FR 235. Note trimmed of restated values.
